parts.name: Button (Left Click)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, typically located on the top-left side of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for primary clicking actions such as selecting, dragging, and interacting with software interfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button (Right Click)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, located on the top-right side of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for secondary clicking actions such as opening context menus or performing alternate functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Scroll Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of a computer mouse, typically made of rubber for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content and can also act as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its horizontal axis and can be pressed vertically.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the computer mouse, made of durable ABS plastic, housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, houses the electronic components, and serves as the main surface for hand placement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to its internal components but moves as a whole across a surface to control cursor movement.
